A LITTLE THANKSGIVING SPOT
Written and Illustrated by: Diane Alber

A Little Thanksgiving Spot is about a “SPOT” that shares all the things he’s thankful for. From simple joys like a sunrise or hot cocoa, to family and big feelings. Along the way, he encourages readers to create their own list of thanks and to remember that gratitude can happen every day, not just on Thanksgiving.

To support the authors, illustrators and publishers of these great books, make sure to get your own copy as nothing can replace turning a page of a book!
